connect.title: LinkedIn matut mahkai u
connect.intro: Na a ads ni hpe hparan ya ai LinkedIn account hte shang wa u. Leadrat na a ad account ni, Lead Gen Form lead ni hte ad jahpan ni hpe sha hti nna, nang hpaw ai galai shai ai lam ni hpe sa ya ai.
connect.need1: LinkedIn ad account kaw na lit langai (Viewer (sh) dai hta jan ai).
connect.need2: Link galaw da ai company a laika man hta lit langai (Uphkang Du, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator (sh) Analyst) - LinkedIn gaw ningbaw ni hpe garan gachyan na matu ra sharawng ai.
connect.need3: Na a Lead Gen Forms hta phone nambat ga san langai mi - phone nambat n lawm ai lead ni hpe n mai bang ai.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: LinkedIn shi a ningbaw ningla ni kaw na gara gaw tengman ai myit mada shara byin wa ai hpe tsun dan u. LinkedIn ningbaw langai mi lawu na nang lata ai masa de du wa ai shaloi, Leadrat LinkedIn de report galaw ya ai , dai majaw na a campaign report ni gaw ningbaw quality hpe madun dan nna, LinkedIn na a kaja dik htum ningbaw ni hpe ra sharawng ai masha law law hpe mu lu na re. LinkedIn lead ID hte email a langai hkrai na hash hpe sha sa ya ai.
